candidate.user_input: Under the Recoupment policy, what is required if a team member voluntarily leaves GitLab before completing twelve consecutive months of active employment after receiving academic study reimbursement?
candidate.reference: If a team member voluntarily terminates employment before completing twelve consecutive months of active employment, academic study or tuition expenses of $1,000 USD and over must be refunded to GitLab. This policy applies only to academic study reimbursements.
reference_contexts:
## Recoupment policy

If a team member voluntarily terminates employment before completing twelve consecutive months of active employment, academic study or tuition expenses of $1,000 USD and over must be refunded to GitLab.

This policy applies to academic study reimbursements only. Team members should review this requirement before submitting requests that fall under this category.

Academic study or tuition expenses of $1,000 USD and over
Policy applies to academic study reimbursements only
